SELECT ROOM_ID, ROOM_NM, LOCATION, CAPACITY, USE_YN, REMARK, REGIST_DT, UPDT_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEETING_RESERVATION R WHERE R.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID) AS RESERVE_CNT FROM MEETING_ROOM M
AND (ROOM_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR LOCATION LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY USE_YN DESC, ROOM_NM, ROOM_ID
SELECT ROOM_ID, ROOM_NM, LOCATION, CAPACITY FROM MEETING_ROOM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ROOM_NM, ROOM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEETING_ROOM (ROOM_ID, ROOM_NM, LOCATION, CAPACITY, USE_YN, REMARK, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{roomNm}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{useYn}, #{remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEETING_ROOM SET ROOM_NM = #{roomNm}, LOCATION = #{location}, CAPACITY = #{capacity}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, REMARK = #{remark}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEETING_RESERVATION WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
